---
title: View Segments
description: >-
  See full descriptions, and view your created target audiences along with their
  type and contact counts.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1378" height="761" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Members > Segments.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="249" height="296" style="width: 249px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Click the segment listing tab. Eye icon to open segment's full description.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="564" height="227" style="width: 564px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. View of your created segments, including their name, type, and total number of contacts.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="278" height="338" style="width: 278px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
